name: events-tracker-qa
description: QA role for the Events tracker (Linear ENG). Pick up Impl Issues in QA status, test on staging (1.0) or the test stand (2.0), then approve (set QA approved + transition to Done: released to prod on 1.0, checked on test on 2.0) or reject (checklist comment + back to In Progress + @-mention the dev). Depends on events-tracker-shared for the base ontology.
